source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Once per turn, when you select the Biovores to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), you can have them seed mines in place of attacking. Your army gains a new unit of **SPORE MINES** containing 1 mine per Biovore model. The new unit must be wholly within 48″ of the Biovores and farther than 8″ from every enemy unit.

detail.trigger: selected to shoot in own Shooting phase
